## The course at a glance {.smaller}

| | |
|---|---|
| **Course** | ID-5-02 (TO) — Mathematical Foundations of Diffusion Models |
| **Instructors** | Uma Satyaranjan · Soma S Dhavala |
| **Structure** | L-T-P 3-0-0 · 3 credits · Open Elective |
| **Open to** | All B.Tech (2^nd^ year+), M.Tech, M.Sc, MS(R), PhD |

Any change will be announced in class and on the site's Assignments page.

## The 40 hours, in six modules {.smaller}

| Module | Topic | Hours |
|:---:|---|:---:|
| 1 | Foundations of generative modeling | 6 |
| 2 | Gaussians and noise accumulation | 6 |
| 3 | Discrete diffusion: the DDPM framework | 6 |
| 4 | Score matching and denoising | 6 |
| 5 | Continuous time: SDEs, Fokker–Planck | 8 |
| 6 | Reverse-time dynamics and probability flow | 8 |

## What we expect from you

- Comfort with **probability** (conditioning, expectation, Gaussians) and **linear algebra** — we will refresh, not reteach
- The ML prerequisite: you have seen likelihoods, loss functions, gradient descent
- Pen-and-paper derivations are the heart of this course — the exams look like the homeworks
- The mini project: a *small* working sampler, not a product

## How to do well {.center}

Come to class. Do the five homeworks yourself.

Every exam question will have a sibling in the homeworks or the weekly notes.
